scope:
CNG 1.0 measurement record for the published pages. For every corpus image (.build/cng_streams/: the CNG file,
its samples, PNG level 9 and lossless WebP files written by research.encode_tiled_corpus): file sizes against
OptiPNG -o7 (results/optipng_reference.json), and median times from memory into one buffer of
  CNG decode at 1 and 4 threads (native/cng, the library's codec sources), libpng decode of the PNG level 9 file,
  libwebp decode of the WebP file; CNG encode at 1 and 4 threads; PNG level 9 encode (Pillow, libpng + zlib).
Run alone on an otherwise idle machine. Writes results/cng_benchmark.json.
    python -B -m research.benchmark_cng [--limit N]
